# Paging on an empty store: next and last stay enabled, last goes to page 0

## Context

Measured by @sloemo01 in PR #19049 — the arm *"an empty store leaves next and last enabled, and last lands on page 0"* — and recorded there as-is, because #19038 is a coverage ticket that forbids fixing what it finds. This ticket is where the behaviour gets decided; that spec will pin whichever way it lands.

## The Problem

With `store.totalCount === 0`:

- `getMaxPages()` (`src/toolbar/Paging.mjs:186`) returns `Math.ceil(0 / pageSize)`, which is `0`, while `currentPage` stays `1`.
- `updateNavigationButtons()` (`:247`) disables next and last on `currentPage === maxPages` — `1 === 0` is false, so both stay **enabled**, while first and prev are disabled by `currentPage === 1`.
- Clicking last runs `onLastPageButtonClick()` (`:200`), which assigns `currentPage = getMaxPages()`: page `0`, below the first page, and the store is then asked to load it.
- The page text reads `Page 1 / 0`.

An operator reaches this with the mouse: any paged view over an empty result.

## The Architectural Reality

`getMaxPages()` has four readers, all inside the class — `pagesText_` (`:39`), `onLastPageButtonClick` (`:201`), `onNextPageButtonClick` (`:210`), `updateNavigationButtons` (`:250`) — and none elsewhere under `src/`, `apps/` or `examples/`. A change to its result stays local.

## The Fix

**Recommended: an empty result is one empty page.** `getMaxPages()` returns `Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalCount / pageSize))`. Then `currentPage === maxPages === 1` disables all four buttons, last assigns `1`, next's guard (`1 < 1`) is a no-op, and the text reads `Page 1 / 1`.

**Alternative:** keep `0` pages and disable next and last when `maxPages` is `0`. It keeps `Page 1 / 0` and adds a special case to the comparison, which is why it is not the recommendation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With `totalCount: 0`, all four navigation buttons are disabled.
- [ ] Pressing last on an empty store never sets `currentPage` below `1`.
- [ ] #19049's empty-store arm is updated from the recorded as-is values to the decided behaviour, and reverting the fix turns that arm red.
- [ ] Non-empty behaviour is unchanged: #19049's other arms pass untouched.

## Out of Scope

- A `currentPage` beyond `maxPages` (#19049 records it by assignment). *Corrected 2026-09-23:* assignment is not the only way to reach it. `Store#load()` requests `page: currentPage` and never resets it; only a change of filters, sorters or page size does. So a reload on page 3 whose result has shrunk, to empty or just to fewer pages, leaves the toolbar past its last page. (Source read by @neo-gpt-emmy; I confirmed it against the source.) It stays out of scope here. It is the out-of-range state for any result size, not the empty-store state, and it needs its own decision.

## Related

- #19038 — the coverage ticket; PR #19049 is its spec and should merge first, since this fix edits one of its arms.
